name: The Andaman
insider_take: Nestled within a 10-million-year-old rainforest on the shores of the Andaman Sea, this isn't just a luxury resort — it's a living, breathing natural sanctuary where the jungle meets the ocean in the most spectacular fashion.
whats_special: Ancient Rainforest Setting: The Andaman is built within one of the world's oldest rainforests, home to rare flora and a resident colony of dusky leaf monkeys that roam freely through the property. Coral Rehabilitation Program: The resort runs an award-winning coral reef rehabilitation program at its private beach — guests can actually participate in nurturing the reef back to life. Luxury Collection Pedigree: As part of Marriott's prestigious Luxury Collection and bookable through the STARS program, The Andaman delivers genuinely curated local experiences tied deeply to Langkawi's natural heritage. Stunning Datai Bay Location: Situated on the coveted Datai Bay — consistently ranked among Asia's most beautiful beaches — the resort offers calm, crystal-clear waters framed by ancient jungle canopy.
pro_tip: Book a room or suite with direct rainforest views and wake up to the sounds of exotic birds and the occasional monkey sighting right from your balcony. Request an early check-in to maximize your time at Datai Bay before the day heats up — mornings here are absolutely magical.
dont_miss: The Jungle Walk: Join the resort's resident naturalist for a guided trek through the ancient rainforest — you'll spot rare orchids, monitor lizards, and if you're lucky, the famous dusky leaf monkeys up close. Swimming with the Reef: Participate in the coral rehabilitation snorkeling experience — a truly unique and meaningful activity you simply won't find at most luxury resorts. The Andaman's Spa: Indulge in a treatment inspired by ancient Malay healing rituals, set within a serene jungle spa environment for an unforgettable wellness experience.
pros: Pristine beachfront location on Datai Bay with crystal clear waters
Surrounded by ancient rainforest and UNESCO World Heritage Geopark
Luxurious overwater villas and stunning architectural design
World-class spa and wellness facilities integrated with natural surroundings
cons: Remote location requires transportation to reach main attractions
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
